result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: an untranslated localization key and an awkwardly clipped category item.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key “home_feed.popular_title” instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation mapping and display the intended localized heading, such as “Popular near you.”

issues.description: A category pill is cut off at the far right with none of its label visible, making it look like a broken or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or initial scroll position so part of the next label is visible, or keep the final fully visible pill aligned within the viewport.
